prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Production asset sheet for a monochrome Chinese ink-wash animated short about Napoleon's Egypt expedition, 1798. Create a high-resolution 2 by 2 grid on transparent background, FOUR isolated matching assets, no grid lines, no labels, no text. Same three-quarter side view facing right. Top left: complete late 18th-century French 74-gun ship of the line, three wooden masts, complete believably hand-drawn fine rigging, curved billowing square canvas sails, layered wooden hull and gunports, entire ship including bowsprit with generous margin. Top right: the SAME ship HULL only, gun deck and railings but NO masts, NO sails, NO ropes above the deck, floating waterline flat baseline. Bottom left: the SAME ship's MAIN MAST assembly alone, tall organic wooden mast, cross spars, two pale billowing sails, all supporting fine ropes contained within assembly, bottom pivot visible. Bottom right: damaged version of the SAME mast assembly, torn limp cloth and broken rigging but a clear lower pivot. Matching scale within equal rectangular cells, no overlap, no sea/no background. Style MUST be expressive traditional sumi-e / xuan paper ink wash, brush contour, dry-brush broken edges, subtle wet-ink blooms and pools, pale gray sail washes with ink-dark seams, dense charcoal hull strokes, painterly varied black / gray only, elegant sparse detail. Avoid photorealism, CGI, 3D shading, glossy surfaces, geometric rectangular sails, symbols, pseudo lettering, color, cartoon outlines, frame borders.

Use case historical-scene. Create one high-resolution animation sprite sheet, a strict 4 columns x 4 rows grid of SIXTEEN consecutive keyframes of the SAME 1798 French infantry soldier walking to the RIGHT in side view. Transparent background. No labels, no numbers, no divider lines. Entire head and boots within every equal cell, generous transparent margins. Identical camera orthographic SIDE VIEW, height, identity, costume, face, hat, musket and knapsack throughout. Classic bicorne hat, long-tailed coat, white cross belts and trousers, dark gaiters, one flintlock musket held steadily on shoulder, canvas knapsack; historically appropriate 1798 NOT modern shako. All monochrome BLACK and GRAY ONLY. ONE FULL walk cycle sequentially row-major: frames 1-4 left heel contact -> load -> passing -> rising; frames 5-8 left support/toe off -> right heel contact; frames 9-12 right loading -> passing -> rising; frames 13-16 right support -> toe off -> return to near left heel contact. Natural grounded upright marching gait, moderate anatomical stride, distinct left and right legs swinging, planted foot stable at contact, opposite arm restrained swing. Each cell contains one complete consistent soldier at same scale, feet centered on same baseline, NOT sixteen unrelated standing poses. Style: hand-painted Chinese ink wash animation, loose expressive brush contour, dark ink hat/coat, dry brush broken outlines, pale watery folds, softly feathered edges. NO 3D, NO photographic crosshatching, no sepia, no colored uniforms, no shadows painted around sprite, no background landscape, no text. This will be played as pose-by-pose animation; accurate coherent temporal leg progression matters.

Use case historical-scene. Create a NEW animation sheet using Image 1 ONLY as the identity and costume reference. Exact SAME gray-ink French bicorne infantryman and musket. Strict 4 columns by 2 rows, EIGHT different consecutive frames, SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT, fixed body height/camera. Transparent background, NO labels. The previous sheet had too many extended-stride poses: this sheet MUST have feet close together and feet crossing under the hips in half the cells, and distinct far/near leg positions. Show a TRUE textbook walking gait with natural knees, NO repeated walking pose. Cell1 LEFT foot heel planted far ahead, right toes behind (contact). Cell2 left sole planted, left knee bent slightly; right foot lifts off, body lowers (down). Cell3 left sole directly UNDER hip; RIGHT bent knee swings forward past it with right ankle OFF GROUND close to left calf (passing). Cell4 left planted foot slightly behind hip, right knee forward, right foot airborne and reaching (up). Cell5 RIGHT foot heel planted ahead, left toes behind (opposite contact). Cell6 right sole planted and knee takes weight; LEFT foot lifting behind (opposite down). Cell7 right foot directly UNDER hip; LEFT bent knee crossing it in front, left ankle OFF GROUND close to right calf (opposite passing). Cell8 right heel rising behind hip; left foot reaching ahead airborne (opposite up). The passing cells 3 and7 must look almost NARROW with legs under torso, NOT two boots widely spread. Keep musket steady, coat same, natural upright body, toes point forward, no squatting. Every sprite centered in own cell with enough whitespace, no cropping. Draw loosely as Chinese ink wash with dark broken dry brush contours, soft wet gray cloth. No 3D, no backgrounds or color.

Use case historical-scene. Image 1 is ONLY an aesthetic reference for Chinese ink wash: its softly pooled gray wash, broken brush contours, fine paper texture and vast quiet blank spaces. Create a NEW production environment asset sheet with THREE separate portrait landscapes side by side as three equal columns, not a triptych framed artwork. Middle column: Egyptian desert, distant Giza pyramids painted in VERY faint washed ink at top third, a couple of wind-sculpted dunes crossing lower third, darker small rocks bottom left, vast pale open sand in lower center for marching soldiers. STRICT neutral black/gray/offwhite, no red seals, no beige/brown colored painting, no Chinese mountains in Egypt, no text, no frames, no CGI, no photographic detail or shading. Keep edge of each column clearly separated by pale blank gutter. High resolution.

Historical-scene animation sprite sheet. Create TWO rows of six cells, TWELVE coherent sequential frames of Napoleon Bonaparte in 1798, SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT, monochrome Chinese ink-wash. Strictly gray/black only; no brown, no lettering, no drop shadow, no numbers, no text, no 3D or digital plastic shading.
